output.summary: Review 2 of 4a84203..23de7dd: C1, C2, I1-I4, M1 and M2 are fixed, and each fix has a test that fails under its mutation. No Critical finding. Important: (I1) a PR the Hub stops tracking when an approval ends (addTasks, reverify, failed, cancel) stays open on GitHub, follows the Story base, and a person can still merge unchecked content into main; (I2) a Story failing after its push re-runs the full VM check every tick. Minors: merge-tree needs git 2.38 or later; addTasks reopens done Stories; the problem memo is not cleared; a small window between the approval re-read and the merge; no column migration (the table is new); an opened PR merged by a person at another head.

evaluation.feedback: Implement attempt 3 (the last). I1: when an approval ends or a Story is cancelled, the Hub keeps every open, unmerged Story PR as withdrawn; the PL Office closes each with a comment (gh pr close), reports it withdrawn, and the Hub forgets it. I2: remember a passed re-check by repo and head, so a later failure does not re-run the VM. M3: clear the problem memo on progress. The other Minors are recorded (git 2.38 or later for merge-tree; addTasks on done is V18's feedback flow; the window between the re-read and the merge; an opened PR merged by a person at another head).
